mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, member_id FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_account (tenant_id, member_id, credit_score, credit_level, create_by, create_time, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, 100, 1, #{operatorId}, NOW(), 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_delete = 0, update_by = VALUES(create_by), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT credit_score AS creditScore, credit_level AS creditLevel FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_account WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_account SET credit_score = #{score}, credit_level = #{level}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_record (tenant_id, member_id, record_no, event_type, score_before, score_change, score_after, reason, source_no, reversal_of_record_no, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{recordNo}, #{eventType}, #{scoreBefore}, #{scoreChange}, #{scoreAfter}, #{reason}, #{sourceNo}, #{reversalOfRecordNo}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{operatorId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT record_no AS recordNo, event_type AS eventType, score_before AS scoreBefore, score_change AS scoreChange, score_after AS scoreAfter, source_no AS sourceNo, reversal_of_record_no AS reversalOfRecordNo FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND record_no = #{recordNo} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND reversal_of_record_no = #{recordNo} AND is_delete = 0

SELECT record_no, event_type, score_before, score_change, score_after, reason, source_no, reversal_of_record_no, (SELECT reversal.record_no FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_record reversal WHERE reversal.tenant_id = credit.tenant_id AND reversal.member_id = credit.member_id AND reversal.reversal_of_record_no = credit.record_no AND reversal.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY reversal.credit_record_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS reversal_record_no, DATE_FORMAT(credit.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_credit_record credit WHERE credit.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND credit.member_id = #{memberId} AND credit.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, credit_record_id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT record_no, reason_type, blacklist_status, reason, DATE_FORMAT(effective_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS effective_time, DATE_FORMAT(expires_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expires_time, DATE_FORMAT(released_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS released_time, release_remark, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_time FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_blacklist_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_delete = 0 ORDER BY blacklist_status ASC, create_time DESC, blacklist_record_id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_blacklist_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND blacklist_status = 1 AND is_delete = 0 AND (expires_time IS NULL OR expires_time > NOW())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ry_rental.ry_rental_member_blacklist_record (tenant_id, member_id, record_no, reason_type, blacklist_status, reason, effective_time, expires_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{memberId}, #{recordNo}, #{reasonType}, 1, #{reason}, NOW(), #{expiresTime}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), #{operatorId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT blacklist_record_id AS recordId, blacklist_status AS blacklistStatus FROM ry_rental.ry_rental_member_blacklist_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND record_no = #{recordNo} AND is_delete = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ry_rental.ry_rental_member_blacklist_record SET blacklist_status = 2, released_by = #{operatorId}, released_time = NOW(), release_remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE blacklist_record_id = #{recordId} AND blacklist_status = 1 AND is_delete = 0
